HEADER.TITLE: AI features in the pipeline (automatic follow-up)
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Set up sequences of multiple follow-ups per stage with custom delays and specialized AI agents.

EMPTY.NO_PIPELINE_DESCRIPTION: Create a closing flow with stages to set up AI follow-ups for each one.
EMPTY.NO_OPEN_STAGE_TITLE: No open stage in this pipeline
EMPTY.NO_OPEN_STAGE_DESCRIPTION: AI follow-ups only run while the deal is open. Add an open stage to this flow to set up a cadence.
EMPTY.NO_ATTEMPTS_DESCRIPTION: Add the first one: the AI writes to the lead after the chosen time of silence in this context.

EDITOR.TITLE: AI cadence for the stage: {stage}

HINTS.REPLACES: While the card is in this stage, this cadence replaces the AI agent's own follow-up.
HINTS.FUTURE_SILENCE: It only applies to silences that start after it is saved and activated.
HINTS.RESTART: Any customer reply restarts the cadence from the first follow-up.
HINTS.TAKES_BACK: After each message the AI takes the conversation back, keeping the card owner.

EDITOR.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the cadences of this pipeline.
EDITOR.AGENTS_LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the AI agents.

DELETE_DIALOG.TITLE: Remove cadence?
DELETE_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: The AI follow-ups of the stage "{stage}" stop running and the AI agent's own follow-up applies again.

SCHEDULE.TITLE: When this cadence applies
SCHEDULE.HINT: Each context has its own follow-ups and final action. Only contexts with at least one follow-up are saved.
SCHEDULE.WINDOWS_EMPTY: No window yet: add at least one so the AI knows when to write.

ATTEMPT.EQUIVALENT_NEXT: Equals: {minutes} minutes, counted from the previous follow-up

SENDERS.contact: Customer sent the last one (company did not reply in time)
SENDERS.agent: Company sent the last one (customer did not reply)

SENDER_INFO.contact: Fires when the customer wrote last and the company stayed silent for the time above.
SENDER_INFO.agent: Fires when the company wrote last and the customer stayed silent for the time above.
SENDER_INFO.any: Fires after the time above of silence, whoever wrote last.

ATTEMPT.AGENTS_EMPTY: No active AI agent. Activate one in AI Agents to use it here.
ATTEMPT.PROMPT_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. Remind the lead of the proposal sent, ask if there are open questions and offer a call.
ATTEMPT.PROMPT_HINT: The agent writes the message from these instructions and the conversation history.
ATTEMPT.NEXT_PILL: If the lead still does not reply, moves on to the next follow-up

NO_RESPONSE.TITLE: If the customer does not reply after the last attempt
NO_RESPONSE.INACTIVITY_HINT: Counted after the last follow-up. Shared by every context of this cadence.
NO_RESPONSE.ACTION_HINT: Runs once per silence; a customer reply cancels it.

ACTIONS.assign: Hand over to a human agent

NO_RESPONSE.CLOSE_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. We are closing this conversation for now. Whenever you want to pick it up, just write to us!
NO_RESPONSE.CLOSE_MESSAGE_HINT: Sent to the customer before the conversation is finalized. Shared by every context of this cadence.

ERRORS.AGENT_REQUIRED: Choose an AI agent for this follow-up.
ERRORS.DELAY_REQUIRED: Enter a time of at least 1 minute.
ERRORS.WINDOW_REQUIRED: Fill in the start and end of every window.
ERRORS.NO_ATTEMPTS: Add at least one follow-up before saving.
ERRORS.VALIDATION: Review the highlighted fields before saving.
